caseName: Delta Family-Care Disability and Survivorship Plan v. Regula
caseNameFull: Delta Family-Care Disability and Survivorship Plan v. Regula

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motions of Bert Bell/ Pete Rozelle NFL Player Retirement Plan and ERISA Industry Committee for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Cer-tiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Black & Decker Disability Plan v. Nord, 538 U. S. 822 (2003).
